description: This file implements REST API endpoints for managing teacher user accounts, including creation, listing, retrieval by ID, updating, and deletion. It leverages FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic for data validation. The endpoints are secured with JWT-based authentication and interact with the User model and UserRepository for database operations.

classes.name: TeacherCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new teacher, including username, full name, email, password, and role.

classes.name: TeacherUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating teacher details, allowing partial updates to full name, email, and password.

classes.name: TeacherOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for output representation of a teacher, including id, username, full name, email, and role.

methods.name: create_teacher(teacher: TeacherCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new teacher account, ensuring username and email uniqueness, hashing the password, and storing in the database.

methods.name: list_teachers(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of all teachers with pagination support.

methods.name: get_teacher(teacher_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific teacher by their ID.

methods.name: update_teacher(teacher_id: int, update: TeacherUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to update teacher profile details, including password hashing if password is updated.

methods.name: delete_teacher(teacher_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a teacher from the database by ID.
